Spotify's own data download (spotify.com/account/privacy, "Account data") takes a few days and brings every playlist and your Liked Songs: unzip it and choose Playlist1.json and YourLibrary.json. Playlists exported from the Music app work too.

Aus der Musik-App exportierte Playlists gehen auch.
